cards.answer: Graves is a marksman whose shotgun attacks deal more damage when multiple pellets hit the same target, with reloads interrupting his attacks. His damage focus is AD and physical damage, and Quickdraw lets him dash, reload and gain resistances.
cards.counterplay: Use intervening units to obstruct his pellets, create distance, and pressure him during reloads.

cards.answer: Graves fires shotgun pellets in a cone; each pellet stops at the first enemy it hits, and landing multiple pellets on the same target increases damage. He cannot basic attack while reloading an empty shotgun. Non-champions hit by multiple pellets are knocked back.
cards.counterplay: Use intervening units to obstruct pellets and look for pressure during reloads.

cards.answer: End of the Line deals physical damage along its path, then detonates across its endpoint and back along its powder trail. Hitting terrain makes the detonation happen sooner.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the trail and avoid fighting against terrain where the detonation comes sooner.

cards.answer: Smoke Screen deals magic damage and briefly slows enemies on impact. Enemies inside the lingering smoke are nearsighted, reducing their vision.
cards.counterplay: Leave the smoke and reposition before committing to a fight.

cards.answer: Quickdraw dashes and reloads a shell while granting stacking armor and magic resistance; dashing toward an enemy champion grants more stacks. Pellet hits reduce its remaining cooldown. Further Quickdraw casts and damage against non-minions refresh the resistance buff.
cards.counterplay: Create distance to limit pellet hits, and avoid prolonged trades while his resistances are stacked.

cards.answer: Collateral Damage fires a physical-damage shell and recoils Graves backward. The shell explodes on hitting an enemy champion or reaching maximum range, dealing reduced damage to additional enemies in a cone.
cards.counterplay: Move off the firing line and spread away from allies in the explosion's path.
